## Summary

Describe the change and the analyst problem it solves.

## Change type

- [ ] Framework / standard
- [ ] Tool / platform
- [ ] Relationship mapping
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Site / UX
- [ ] Automation / schema
- [ ] Lifecycle / provenance correction

## Evidence

For catalog changes, provide the canonical upstream and explain:

- maintainer / organization;
- maintenance state;
- license or commercial model;
- correct taxonomy;
- supported domains;
- why the entry belongs in the verified core instead of the watchlist.

## Validation

- [ ] I ran or expect CI to run schema/integrity validation.
- [ ] I did not add unsupported marketing claims.
- [ ] I did not add destructive operational instructions.
- [ ] New relationships are descriptive and do not overstate equivalence.
- [ ] Documentation links use primary sources where practical.

## Notes

Add migration, rename, successor, deprecation or compatibility context if relevant.
